## Scope

Describe the current behavior, the reason for the change, and the smallest
affected surface.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Separate passed checks, skipped checks,
pre-existing failures, and environment blockers.

## Claim and trust review

- [ ] Capability status and documentation match the implemented boundary.
- [ ] Source immutability, output validation, failure states, and cleanup remain
      explicit where applicable.
- [ ] No dependency, engine, network, credential, or remote-service boundary was
      added without approval.
- [ ] No private PDF content, secret, credential, certificate, key, local path,
      internal URL, or generated local state is included.
- [ ] Generated reports and screenshot manifests were updated only when their
      source data changed.

## Compatibility and release impact

State any effect on runtime behavior, installation, configuration, file formats,
data, public APIs, CLI contracts, or release metadata. Write `none` when there
is no effect.
